slides.lead: You do. You're just waiting for a win. Here's what to share while you build.
Explain the problem you're solving. People follow problems they recognize.

slides.h2: Show why you chose X over Y.
slides.lead: Feature you cut. Market you picked. Tool you dropped. Decisions are content.
An App Store rejection teaches more people than a launch announcement.

slides.h2: Share the test, not just the result.
slides.lead: What you tried, what you expected, what you'll do next. Even before the numbers land.
Polished posts get likes. Behind-the-scenes posts get followers.
"Would you use this?" "What would you cut?" Your audience becomes your feedback loop.

slides.h2: You don't need a win to start posting.
